title: Construct the section-valued comparison sheaf functor
statement:
For a scheme X there is a functor A from etale set sheaves on X to pro-etale set sheaves on X, with equivalences A(F)(Y) ≃ Gamma(Y_et,Y.hom^*F). These equivalences intertwine restrictions with the specified inverse-image unit and terminal transport, and intertwine coefficient morphisms with inverse-image morphisms on terminal sections. This statement constructs the functor and its laws; it asserts no comparison-inverse-image isomorphism or adjunction.
Conventions: small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]; small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]; sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]; inverse images, their units and composition isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]; terminal section transport [def-weil-pbc-sets-terminal-transport].

source.place: Tag 0GLZ, presheaf construction and first proof paragraph

proof.text: Use values of Y.hom^*F at the pullback of the terminal etale X-object. Define maps by etaleSetSectionComparison. Its identity and composition equations prove the presheaf laws.

The second pullback projection identifies these values with terminal sections. Unit and composition-map naturality, with uniqueness of maps to a terminal object, identifies the restriction maps with the required terminal transport formula.

Apply the single-presheaf descent theorem to obtain sheaves. Coefficient maps are evaluation of inverse-image morphisms; unit naturality and composition-isomorphism naturality prove they define natural transformations, and inverse-image functor laws give A functor laws.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleComparisonSectionFunctor (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ A : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)) ⥤
        Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (Type (u + 1)),
      ∃ e : ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (Y : X.ProEt),
        (A.obj F).obj.obj (op Y) ≃
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F).obj.obj
            (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))),
      (∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
        (Y Z : X.ProEt) (g : Z ⟶ Y) (s : (A.obj F).obj.obj (op Y)),
        e F Z ((A.obj F).obj.map g.op s) =
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g.left) (Type (u + 1))
            (Y.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (Z.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
              ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F)).hom.app
                (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))) ≫
            (etaleSetTerminalTransport Y.hom g.left Z.hom (MorphismProperty.Over.w g) F).inv) (e F
              Y s)) ∧
      (∀ (F F' : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (ψ : F ⟶ F')
        (Y : X.ProEt) (s : (A.obj F).obj.obj (op Y)),
        e F' Y ((A.map ψ).hom.app (op Y) s) =
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).map ψ).hom.app
            (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))) (e F Y s))
